title: GRAD9 | רמת משחק לדוגמה
originalBrief: Continue the existing GRAD_9 scene as the complete sample gameplay level. Connect its current work to the website, including existing waves, routes, towers, real QA and beginning-to-victory acceptance. Preserve GRAD11 and other unsaved Unity work; do not create a replacement level.

gaps.description: No continuous beginning-to-victory Play evidence or multiplayer smoke verification.
Preview inspection found active QA_TOWER_SHOWCASE_10_TYPES with 12 direct tower children. Verify dependencies before disabling test-only content.
Waves at km238 and km250 use 7/6 slots with 3-second teleport settings. Actual overlap, scheduler behavior and kill time remain unmeasured.
GRAD_9 historical images exist in repository, but no matching Timeline is in current Level QA index. A fresh native export is required; do not substitute GRAD2 or infer routes.

lastCompletedAction: 2026-10-25: Existing continuation plan inspected. It records native preview inspection of 22 WavesManager entries and 12 active QA showcase tower instances. No fresh continuous Play run or victory evidence. Website dossier connected; historical images remain references rather than accepted QA.
nextAction: Preserve unsaved GRAD1; establish one Unity operator and safe save state. Continue the existing GRAD_9 scene, inspect the active QA showcase, measure actual enemy concurrency and teleport timing, then capture continuous start-to-boss-to-victory gameplay. Do not tune waves from counts alone.
